meta.title: invita — Digital invitations & RSVP
meta.description: Beautiful digital invitations with effortless RSVPs in Lao, Thai and English.

landing.title: Invite beautifully. Hear back instantly.
landing.subtitle: invita turns your event into a polished invitation that guests can answer in a single tap, in Lao, Thai or English.

oneClick.title: 1-click RSVP
oneClick.body: Guests tap Attending or Not attending. No sign-up and no passwords to remember.

personal.title: Personal, private links
personal.body: Every guest gets a unique link, and invitations can be protected with a password.

live.title: Real-time dashboard
live.body: Watch responses, headcount and dietary needs update the moment guests answer.

invitation.inviteOnlyBody: RSVP is only available through the personal link the hosts sent you. Please open that link to respond.

rsvp.title: Will you join us?
rsvp.subtitle: Tap one button to let us know. It takes a second and needs no sign-up.
rsvp.thanksAttending: Wonderful, we can't wait to see you!
rsvp.thanksDeclined: We will miss you. Thank you for letting us know.
rsvp.detailsTitle: A few details to help us plan

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.closed: RSVP for this event is now closed.
errors.invalidLink: This personal link is not valid.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.liveHint: Updates the moment a guest responds
dashboard.demoNote: Showing demo data. Connect Supabase to see real responses.
